acceptance.given: A historical replay record and its pinned equivalent current inputs are available; the replay is executed through the repository-owned replay entry point.

oracle.expected: The resulting current replay record contains newly captured process evidence attributable to the current execution and an explicit statement delimiting what historical facts are treated as equivalent; historical process evidence alone cannot satisfy the result.
forbidden: The result is accepted using only historical process evidence.
The current replay record omits the equivalence-boundary statement.
The replay evidence is copied or inferred without launching the current replay process.
oracle.observable: The current replay artifact records a fresh process receipt (including current execution identity/output) and a non-empty equivalence-boundary statement, with both linked to the replay input identity.

acceptance.then: A current equivalent replay is independently evidenced as fresh, bounded process execution and its historical-equivalence limits are explicit.
acceptance.when: After executing the current equivalent replay and materializing its replay result for semantic evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 replay test against a fixture whose result relies on historical evidence, omits the equivalence-boundary field, or suppresses the current process receipt; the test must observe the runtime marker and fail deterministically.

affected_subjects: Historical equivalent replay of frozen historical evidence
slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the Toolchain replay path so a current equivalent replay emits attributable fresh process evidence and an explicit equivalence-boundary statement while preserving historical records as non-authorizing reference data.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback removes only the new current-replay evidence/boundary emission and restores the prior replay behavior; frozen historical evidence and its bytes remain unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: Historical evidence present -> execute current equivalent replay -> bind fresh process receipt and equivalence boundary -> publish non-authorizing replay result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass only when the current replay process receipt is newly created and bound to the replay identity, and the equivalence-boundary statement is present; otherwise terminate unsuccessful.
